title: Q & R: Podcasts on the whole Bible

body:
Q: Hi! Are Brian’s podcasts on the whole Bible available anywhere else other than

Emergent Village’s website? The Emergent Village podcast cast page has not

been updated in months and I have tried a google search for the podcasts but

cannot find them anywhere. Thank you for any help and assistance you can

provide me.

R: Thanks for asking. I’m working on a way to make these available. Stay tuned – it will probably take a couple of weeks. They should be available through my site here at /archive I put a lot of time, energy, and heart into these, so I’d love to get them out there again. I’m glad to hear of your interest!
